name: lynxship
description: A small, testable LynxJS build, submit and OTA control plane.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lynxship/cli build && pnpm --filter create-lynxship-app build && tsx --test test/core.test.ts test/api.test.ts test/cli.test.ts test/cli-ui.test.ts test/create-app.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @lynxship/dashboard build && tsx scripts/verify-release.ts
